description: Source code for the DriverKubernetesCredentialsFeatureStep class in Apache Spark, handling Kubernetes credentials configuration for Spark driver pods.

classes.name: DriverKubernetesCredentialsFeatureStep
classes.description: Handles mounting Kubernetes credentials into Spark driver pods based on configuration.

methods.name: configurePod
methods.description: Configures the SparkPod with Kubernetes credentials, mounting secrets if necessary.

methods.name: getAdditionalPodSystemProperties
methods.description: Returns system properties related to mounted Kubernetes credentials.

methods.name: getAdditionalKubernetesResources
methods.description: Provides Kubernetes Secret resources if credentials need to be mounted.

methods.name: safeFileConfToBase64
methods.description: Reads a file and encodes its contents in Base64, used for secret data.

methods.name: resolveSecretData
methods.description: Creates a map for secret data from an optional credential string.

methods.name: resolveSecretLocation
methods.description: Determines the secret location based on user input or defaults.

methods.name: createCredentialsSecret
methods.description: Builds a Kubernetes Secret object containing credentials data.
